decisions.reason: The protection cap is a low-investment accessory with only a dedicated page rather than home-page visibility, so little sunk cost or public commitment justifies continuing it.

Although not on the home page, the car transporter line involves substantial investment and a dedicated page, so escalation of commitment favors keeping it while results are still early.
The low-bed series is a substantial product line with home-page visibility, so the firm is likely to persist despite any early disappointing results.
